playstyle.identity: Master Yi is a reset-based melee carry who becomes untargetable during Q and gains massive attack speed with R. He excels at cleaning up teamfights.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: every few autos, strike twice. Q makes you untargetable while bouncing to enemies (reduced CD on auto). W channels to heal and reduce damage. E gives true damage on autos. R gives speed and attack speed, extends on kill. Q to dodge, R for cleanup.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Master Yi spikes with attack speed items and at level 6. Guinsoo's and Kraken make him deadly. He's a late-game hypercarry.

passive.name: Double Strike
passive.details: Every few basic attacks, Master Yi strikes twice. The second strike deals reduced damage but applies on-hit effects.

abilities.name: Alpha Strike
abilities.summary: Become untargetable and bounce between enemies; cooldown reduced by autos.
abilities.details: Master Yi becomes untargetable, bouncing between enemies and dealing damage. Each auto attack reduces the cooldown.

abilities.name: Meditate
abilities.summary: Channel to heal and take reduced damage.
abilities.details: Master Yi channels, healing himself and gaining massive damage reduction. Can be cancelled early.

abilities.name: Wuju Style
abilities.summary: Passive: bonus AD. Active: deal true damage on autos for several seconds.
abilities.details: Passive: Gain bonus attack damage. Active: For a few seconds, basic attacks deal bonus true damage.

abilities.name: Highlander
abilities.summary: Gain massive speed and attack speed; duration extends on takedown.
abilities.details: Master Yi gains movement speed, attack speed, and immunity to slows. The duration extends with each takedown.
